# R5465, page 1. My own transcription of the DECODE image of this page, as sign labels.
# A label (G001, G002, ...) names one sign shape across the nine records. One line for each row, with its row label. ../TRANSCRIPTION.md explains the marks.
# Credit: DECODE record R5465, https://de-crypt.org/decrypt-web/RecordsView/5465; Archivio di Stato di Milano, Carteggio Sforzesco, cartella 1597. No DECODE image is published.
